public struct FfiSessionSnapshot: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var folder: String
    /**
     * In capture order, which is the batcher's ordinal, not `rel_path`.
     */
    public var photos: [FfiPhotoMeta]
    public var batches: [FfiBatch]
    public var ratings: [UInt64: FfiRating]
    /**
     * Sorted, so a snapshot diff between two renders is stable.
     */
    public var visited: [UInt64]
    public var cursor: FfiCursor?
    /**
     * Batch id → the last photo the user was on in it.
     */
    public var lastPhotoInBatch: [UInt64: UInt64]
    public var skipped: [FfiSkipped]

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(folder: String, 
        /**
         * In capture order, which is the batcher's ordinal, not `rel_path`.
         */photos: [FfiPhotoMeta], batches: [FfiBatch], ratings: [UInt64: FfiRating], 
        /**
         * Sorted, so a snapshot diff between two renders is stable.
         */visited: [UInt64], cursor: FfiCursor?, 
        /**
         * Batch id → the last photo the user was on in it.
         */lastPhotoInBatch: [UInt64: UInt64], skipped: [FfiSkipped]) {
        self.folder = folder
        self.photos = photos
        self.batches = batches
        self.ratings = ratings
        self.visited = visited
        self.cursor = cursor
        self.lastPhotoInBatch = lastPhotoInBatch
        self.skipped = skipped
    }

    

    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiSessionSnapshot: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiSessionSnapshot: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiSessionSnapshot {
        return
            try FfiSessionSnapshot(
                folder: FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf), 
                photos: FfiConverterSequenceTypeFfiPhotoMeta.read(from: &buf), 
                batches: FfiConverterSequenceTypeFfiBatch.read(from: &buf), 
                ratings: FfiConverterDictionaryUInt64TypeFfiRating.read(from: &buf), 
                visited: FfiConverterSequenceUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                cursor: FfiConverterOptionTypeFfiCursor.read(from: &buf), 
                lastPhotoInBatch: FfiConverterDictionaryUInt64UInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                skipped: FfiConverterSequenceTypeFfiSkipped.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiSessionSnapshot, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterString.write(value.folder, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterSequenceTypeFfiPhotoMeta.write(value.photos, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterSequenceTypeFfiBatch.write(value.batches, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterDictionaryUInt64TypeFfiRating.write(value.ratings, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterSequenceUInt64.write(value.visited, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterOptionTypeFfiCursor.write(value.cursor, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterDictionaryUInt64UInt64.write(value.lastPhotoInBatch, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterSequenceTypeFfiSkipped.write(value.skipped, into: &buf)
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiSessionSnapshot_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiSessionSnapshot {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiSessionSnapshot.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiSessionSnapshot_lower(_ value: FfiSessionSnapshot) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiSessionSnapshot.lower(value)
}

/**
 * A photo's visual signature with no photo attached, as computed from one thumbnail.
 */
public struct FfiVisualSig: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var dhash: UInt64
    /**
     * 48 bins: 16 each for R, G, B.
     */
    public var hist: Data

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(dhash: UInt64, 
        /**
         * 48 bins: 16 each for R, G, B.
         */hist: Data) {
        self.dhash = dhash
        self.hist = hist
    }

    

    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiVisualSig: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSig: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiVisualSig {
        return
            try FfiVisualSig(
                dhash: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                hist: FfiConverterData.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiVisualSig, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.dhash, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterData.write(value.hist, into: &buf)
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSig_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiVisualSig {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSig.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSig_lower(_ value: FfiVisualSig) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSig.lower(value)
}


/**
 * One photo's visual signature, as the pipeline computed it from the thumbnail.
 */
public struct FfiVisualSigEntry: Equatable, Hashable {
    public var photo: UInt64
    /**
     * Bit `row * 8 + col` is `luma[row][col] > luma[row][col + 1]`, MSB first.
     */
    public var dhash: UInt64
    /**
     * 16 bins each for R, G, B, each channel normalized so its largest bin is 255. A
     * `[u8; 48]` on the Rust side; UniFFI has no fixed-size-array support, so it travels as an
     * array and is 48 long on the Swift side too.
     */
    public var hist: Data

    // Default memberwise initializers are never public by default, so we
    // declare one manually.
    public init(photo: UInt64, 
        /**
         * Bit `row * 8 + col` is `luma[row][col] > luma[row][col + 1]`, MSB first.
         */dhash: UInt64, 
        /**
         * 16 bins each for R, G, B, each channel normalized so its largest bin is 255. A
         * `[u8; 48]` on the Rust side; UniFFI has no fixed-size-array support, so it travels as an
         * array and is 48 long on the Swift side too.
         */hist: Data) {
        self.photo = photo
        self.dhash = dhash
        self.hist = hist
    }

    

    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiVisualSigEntry: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSigEntry: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiVisualSigEntry {
        return
            try FfiVisualSigEntry(
                photo: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                dhash: FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf), 
                hist: FfiConverterData.read(from: &buf)
        )
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiVisualSigEntry, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.photo, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterUInt64.write(value.dhash, into: &buf)
        FfiConverterData.write(value.hist, into: &buf)
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSigEntry_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiVisualSigEntry {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSigEntry.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSigEntry_lower(_ value: FfiVisualSigEntry) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiVisualSigEntry.lower(value)
}


/**
 * How photos are grouped into batches: Plays merges neighbouring bursts, Bursts does not.
 */

public enum FfiBatchingMode: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case plays
    case bursts





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiBatchingMode: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiBatchingMode: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiBatchingMode

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiBatchingMode {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .plays
        
        case 2: return .bursts
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiBatchingMode, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .plays:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case .bursts:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif

    return FfiConverterTypeFfiBatchingMode.lower(value)

/**
 * Every failure Swift has to tell apart. Never a bare `String`: todo.md §8 says a failure is
 * reported, never a panic, and an app that cannot tell "no such folder" from "the card is locked"
 * cannot show the user anything useful.
 */
public 
enum FfiError: Swift.Error, Equatable, Hashable, Foundation.LocalizedError {

    
    
    case Scan(message: String
    )
    case Session(message: String
    )

    

    

    
    public var errorDescription: String? {
        String(reflecting: self)
    }
    
}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiError: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiError: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiError

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiError {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {

        

        
        case 1: return .Scan(
            message: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
            )
        case 2: return .Session(
            message: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
            )

         default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiError, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {

        

        
        
        case let .Scan(message):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
            FfiConverterString.write(message, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .Session(message):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
            FfiConverterString.write(message, into: &buf)
            
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiError_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiError {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiError.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiError_lower(_ value: FfiError) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiError.lower(value)
}


/**
 * Mirrors `crate::meta::FileKind` and Swift's `FileKind`, including the `raw(format)` case.
 */

public enum FfiFileKind: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case raw(FfiRawFormat
    )
    case jpeg
    case heif
    case tiff
    case png





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiFileKind: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiFileKind: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiFileKind

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiFileKind {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .raw(try FfiConverterTypeFfiRawFormat.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 2: return .jpeg
        
        case 3: return .heif
        
        case 4: return .tiff
        
        case 5: return .png
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiFileKind, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case let .raw(v1):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
            FfiConverterTypeFfiRawFormat.write(v1, into: &buf)
            
        
        case .jpeg:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        
        case .heif:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
        
        
        case .tiff:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
        
        
        case .png:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
        
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiFileKind_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiFileKind {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiFileKind.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiFileKind_lower(_ value: FfiFileKind) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiFileKind.lower(value)
}

/**
 * What to do with the photos that were kept. Mirrors `fileops::KeptAction`.
 */

public enum FfiKeptAction: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case none
    case copyTo(folder: String
    )
    case moveTo(folder: String
    )
    case splitByTier(folder: String
    )
    case splitByStars(folder: String
    )
    case writeList(file: String
    )





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiKeptAction: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiKeptAction: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiKeptAction

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiKeptAction {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .none
        
        case 2: return .copyTo(folder: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 3: return .moveTo(folder: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 4: return .splitByTier(folder: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 5: return .splitByStars(folder: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 6: return .writeList(file: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiKeptAction, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .none:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case let .copyTo(folder):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
            FfiConverterString.write(folder, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .moveTo(folder):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
            FfiConverterString.write(folder, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .splitByTier(folder):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
            FfiConverterString.write(folder, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .splitByStars(folder):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
            FfiConverterString.write(folder, into: &buf)
            
        
        case let .writeList(file):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(6))
            FfiConverterString.write(file, into: &buf)
            
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiKeptAction_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiKeptAction {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiKeptAction.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiKeptAction_lower(_ value: FfiKeptAction) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiKeptAction.lower(value)
}



/**
 * How the opened database relates to the folder (docs/contracts/session-api.md).
 */

public enum FfiMatchKind: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case created
    case exact
    /**
     * The folder was moved or renamed and the session came with it. Carries where it was last
     * seen, which the app shows as a note rather than a dialog.
     */
    case moved(from: String
    )





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiMatchKind: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiMatchKind: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiMatchKind

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiMatchKind {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .created
        
        case 2: return .exact
        
        case 3: return .moved(from: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiMatchKind, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .created:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case .exact:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        
        case let .moved(from):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
            FfiConverterString.write(from, into: &buf)
            
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Mirrors `crate::meta::RawFormat` and `CoreTypes.swift`'s `RawFormat`. The same 38 spellings,
 * so the Swift `case .cr3` pattern-matches the generated enum.
 */

public enum FfiRawFormat: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case cr3
    case cr2
    case crw
    case arw
    case sr2
    case srf
    case nef
    case nrw
    case raf
    case rw2
    case orf
    case pef
    case dng
    case rwl
    case threeFr
    case fff
    case iiq
    case srw
    case dcr
    case kdc
    case erf
    case mef
    case mos
    case gpr
    case x3f
    case ori
    case raw
    case mrw
    case arq
    case cap
    case bay
    case k25
    case kc2
    case dcs
    case mdc
    case ari
    case cs1
    case sti





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiRawFormat: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiRawFormat: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiRawFormat

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiRawFormat {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .cr3
        
        case 2: return .cr2
        
        case 3: return .crw
        
        case 4: return .arw
        
        case 5: return .sr2
        
        case 6: return .srf
        
        case 7: return .nef
        
        case 8: return .nrw
        
        case 9: return .raf
        
        case 10: return .rw2
        
        case 11: return .orf
        
        case 12: return .pef
        
        case 13: return .dng
        
        case 14: return .rwl
        
        case 15: return .threeFr
        
        case 16: return .fff
        
        case 17: return .iiq
        
        case 18: return .srw
        
        case 19: return .dcr
        
        case 20: return .kdc
        
        case 21: return .erf
        
        case 22: return .mef
        
        case 23: return .mos
        
        case 24: return .gpr
        
        case 25: return .x3f
        
        case 26: return .ori
        
        case 27: return .raw
        
        case 28: return .mrw
        
        case 29: return .arq
        
        case 30: return .cap
        
        case 31: return .bay
        
        case 32: return .k25
        
        case 33: return .kc2
        
        case 34: return .dcs
        
        case 35: return .mdc
        
        case 36: return .ari
        
        case 37: return .cs1
        
        case 38: return .sti
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiRawFormat, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .cr3:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case .cr2:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        
        case .crw:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
        
        
        case .arw:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
        
        
        case .sr2:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
        
        
        case .srf:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(6))
        
        
        case .nef:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(7))
        
        
        case .nrw:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(8))
        
        
        case .raf:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(9))
        
        
        case .rw2:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(10))
        
        
        case .orf:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(11))
        
        
        case .pef:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(12))
        
        
        case .dng:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(13))
        
        
        case .rwl:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(14))
        
        
        case .threeFr:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(15))
        
        
        case .fff:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(16))
        
        
        case .iiq:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(17))
        
        
        case .srw:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(18))
        
        
        case .dcr:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(19))
        
        
        case .kdc:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(20))
        
        
        case .erf:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(21))
        
        
        case .mef:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(22))
        
        
        case .mos:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(23))
        
        
        case .gpr:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(24))
        
        
        case .x3f:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(25))
        
        
        case .ori:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(26))
        
        
        case .raw:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(27))
        
        
        case .mrw:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(28))
        
        
        case .arq:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(29))
        
        
        case .cap:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(30))
        
        
        case .bay:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(31))
        
        
        case .k25:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(32))
        
        
        case .kc2:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(33))
        
        
        case .dcs:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(34))
        
        
        case .mdc:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(35))
        
        
        case .ari:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(36))
        
        
        case .cs1:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(37))
        
        
        case .sti:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(38))
        
        }
    }
}

@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiRawFormat_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiRawFormat {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiRawFormat.lift(buf)
}

public enum FfiTier: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case keep
    case good
    case maybe
    case unrated
    case rejected





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiTier: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiTier: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiTier

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiTier {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .keep
        
        case 2: return .good
        
        case 3: return .maybe
        
        case 4: return .unrated
        
        case 5: return .rejected
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiTier, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .keep:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case .good:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        
        case .maybe:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
        
        
        case .unrated:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
        
        
        case .rejected:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
        
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiTier_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiTier {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiTier.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiTier_lower(_ value: FfiTier) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiTier.lower(value)
}




public enum FfiTimeSource: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case exif
    /**
     * A guess. The app greys the timestamp so the user knows ordering may be wrong.
     */
    case fileModified





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiTimeSource: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiTimeSource: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiTimeSource

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiTimeSource {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .exif
        
        case 2: return .fileModified
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiTimeSource, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .exif:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case .fileModified:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
        
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiTimeSource_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiTimeSource {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiTimeSource.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiTimeSource_lower(_ value: FfiTimeSource) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiTimeSource.lower(value)
}



/**
 * What to do with the photos that were not kept. Mirrors `fileops::UnkeptAction`.
 */

public enum FfiUnkeptAction: Equatable, Hashable {
    
    case markRejectedInXmp
    case moveToSubfolder(name: String
    )
    case moveToTrash
    case deletePermanently
    case nothing





}

#if compiler(>=6)
extension FfiUnkeptAction: Sendable {}
#endif

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public struct FfiConverterTypeFfiUnkeptAction: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = FfiUnkeptAction

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> FfiUnkeptAction {
        let variant: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        switch variant {
        
        case 1: return .markRejectedInXmp
        
        case 2: return .moveToSubfolder(name: try FfiConverterString.read(from: &buf)
        )
        
        case 3: return .moveToTrash
        
        case 4: return .deletePermanently
        
        case 5: return .nothing
        
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedEnumCase
        }
    }

    public static func write(_ value: FfiUnkeptAction, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        switch value {
        
        
        case .markRejectedInXmp:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(1))
        
        
        case let .moveToSubfolder(name):
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(2))
            FfiConverterString.write(name, into: &buf)
            
        
        case .moveToTrash:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(3))
        
        
        case .deletePermanently:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(4))
        
        
        case .nothing:
            writeInt(&buf, Int32(5))
        
        }
    }
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiUnkeptAction_lift(_ buf: RustBuffer) throws -> FfiUnkeptAction {
    return try FfiConverterTypeFfiUnkeptAction.lift(buf)
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
public func FfiConverterTypeFfiUnkeptAction_lower(_ value: FfiUnkeptAction) -> RustBuffer {
    return FfiConverterTypeFfiUnkeptAction.lower(value)
}


#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
fileprivate struct FfiConverterOptionInt16: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = Int16?

    public static func write(_ value: SwiftType, into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        guard let value = value else {
            writeInt(&buf, Int8(0))
            return
        }
        writeInt(&buf, Int8(1))
        FfiConverterInt16.write(value, into: &buf)
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> SwiftType {
        switch try readInt(&buf) as Int8 {
        case 0: return nil
        case 1: return try FfiConverterInt16.read(from: &buf)
        default: throw UniffiInternalError.unexpectedOptionalTag
        }
    }
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
fileprivate struct FfiConverterSequenceUInt16: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    typealias SwiftType = [UInt16]

    public static func write(_ value: [UInt16], into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        let len = Int32(value.count)
        writeInt(&buf, len)
        for item in value {
            FfiConverterUInt16.write(item, into: &buf)
        }
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> [UInt16] {
        let len: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        var seq = [UInt16]()
        seq.reserveCapacity(Int(len))
        for _ in 0 ..< len {
            seq.append(try FfiConverterUInt16.read(from: &buf))
        }
        return seq
    }
}

    public static func write(_ value: [FfiPhotoRating], into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        let len = Int32(value.count)
        writeInt(&buf, len)
        for item in value {
            FfiConverterTypeFfiPhotoRating.write(item, into: &buf)
        }
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> [FfiPhotoRating] {
        let len: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        var seq = [FfiPhotoRating]()
        seq.reserveCapacity(Int(len))
        for _ in 0 ..< len {
            seq.append(try FfiConverterTypeFfiPhotoRating.read(from: &buf))
        }
        return seq
    }
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
fileprivate struct FfiConverterDictionaryUInt64UInt64: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func write(_ value: [UInt64: UInt64], into buf: inout [UInt8]) {
        let len = Int32(value.count)
        writeInt(&buf, len)
        for (key, value) in value {
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(key, into: &buf)
            FfiConverterUInt64.write(value, into: &buf)
        }
    }

    public static func read(from buf: inout (data: Data, offset: Data.Index)) throws -> [UInt64: UInt64] {
        let len: Int32 = try readInt(&buf)
        var dict = [UInt64: UInt64]()
        dict.reserveCapacity(Int(len))
        for _ in 0..<len {
            let key = try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
            let value = try FfiConverterUInt64.read(from: &buf)
            dict[key] = value
        }
        return dict
    }
}

#if swift(>=5.8)
@_documentation(visibility: private)
#endif
fileprivate struct FfiConverterDictionaryUInt64TypeFfiRating: FfiConverterRustBuffer {
    public static func write(_ value: [UInt64: FfiRating], into buf: inout [UInt8]) {

            FfiConverterTypeFfiRating.write(value, into: &buf)

}

/**
 * The reference signature algorithm from docs/contracts/batching.md, for Swift to call on the
 * thumbnails it decodes (REV-64: the app must use this, never its own copy of the algorithm, or
 * the two sides drift and the ambiguous zone is decided by a hash nobody tested).
 *
 * `rgba` is `width * height * 4` bytes, 8 bits per channel, sRGB, orientation already applied.
 * `None` for a buffer that does not match its stated size, or a zero dimension, rather than a
 * panic across the FFI boundary.
 */
public func computeVisualSig(rgba: Data, width: UInt32, height: UInt32) -> FfiVisualSig?  {
    return try!  FfiConverterOptionTypeFfiVisualSig.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_firstcut_core_fn_func_compute_visual_sig(
        FfiConverterData.lower(rgba),
        FfiConverterUInt32.lower(width),
        FfiConverterUInt32.lower(height),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
/**
 * Crate version, so the About box can say which core is running.
 */
public func coreVersion() -> String  {
    return try!  FfiConverterString.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_firstcut_core_fn_func_core_version(uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
/**
 * The first photograph of a folder by name, without reading any header: Swift
 * `firstPhotoName(path:)`.
 *
 * todo.md §7.3's "folder open → first photo on screen < 1 s" is a two-step fast path: a directory
 * listing names the file, then one header read and one decode put it on screen, all while the full
 * scan reads the other 2,879 headers. Returns `None` for a folder with no photo files, so the
 * caller falls back to the normal open and reports the real error.
 */
public func firstPhotoName(path: String) -> String?  {
    return try!  FfiConverterOptionString.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_firstcut_core_fn_func_first_photo_name(
        FfiConverterString.lower(path),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
/**
 * Wave 1 smoke test: proves the Rust core is linked and callable from Swift.
 */
public func hello() -> String  {
    return try!  FfiConverterString.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_firstcut_core_fn_func_hello(uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
/**
 * One photograph's metadata, read with a single header read: Swift
 * `readPhoto(folder:relPath:)`.
 *
 * The same [`crate::meta::read_photo`] the full scan would have used for that file, so the picture
 * the app shows immediately is the picture the scan returns later. `None` when the file is not a
 * photo, is gone, or does not parse — the caller shows nothing and waits for the scan.
 */
public func readPhoto(folder: String, relPath: String) -> FfiPhotoMeta?  {
    return try!  FfiConverterOptionTypeFfiPhotoMeta.lift(try! rustCall() {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_firstcut_core_fn_func_read_photo(
        FfiConverterString.lower(folder),
        FfiConverterString.lower(relPath),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}
/**
 * Scans a folder of photos: Swift `try scanFolder(path:)`.
 *
 * Headers only, never a whole file. A folder that cannot be opened throws `FfiError.scan`; a
 * file that cannot be read is in `skipped`, so nothing is lost silently.
 */
public func scanFolder(path: String)throws  -> FfiScanResult  {
    return try  FfiConverterTypeFfiScanResult_lift(try rustCallWithError(FfiConverterTypeFfiError_lift) {
        uniffiCallStatus in
    uniffi_firstcut_core_fn_func_scan_folder(
        FfiConverterString.lower(path),uniffiCallStatus
    )
})
}

private enum InitializationResult {
    case ok
    case contractVersionMismatch
    case apiChecksumMismatch
}
// Use a global variable to perform the versioning checks. Swift ensures that
// the code inside is only computed once.
private let initializationResult: InitializationResult = {
    // Get the bindings contract version from our ComponentInterface
    let bindings_contract_version = 30
    // Get the scaffolding contract version by calling the into the dylib
    let scaffolding_contract_version = ffi_firstcut_core_uniffi_contract_version()
    if bindings_contract_version != scaffolding_contract_version {
        return InitializationResult.contractVersionMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_func_compute_visual_sig() != 48268) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_func_core_version() != 33093) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_func_first_photo_name() != 43751) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_func_hello() != 24729) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_func_read_photo() != 27069) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_func_scan_folder() != 58876) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_ffisessionlistener_on_batches_changed() != 3414) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_ffisessionlistener_on_files_changed() != 57455) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_ffisessionlistener_on_xmp_error() != 25220) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_ffisessionlistener_on_session_moved() != 35718) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_batching_mode() != 33574) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_close() != 33080) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_execute_finish() != 15825) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_flush() != 41680) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_folder() != 37005) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_mark_visited() != 61533) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_matched() != 11443) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_plan_finish() != 21033) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_rating_mode() != 35572) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_redo() != 48841) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_redo_step() != 43854) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_rescan() != 64578) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_set_batching_mode() != 12446) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_set_cursor() != 45580) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_set_keep_threshold() != 15072) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_set_rating() != 4411) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_set_rating_mode() != 56683) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_set_ratings() != 64515) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_set_xmp_settings() != 21527) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_snapshot() != 49602) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_submit_visual_sigs() != 13032) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_tier_counts() != 15181) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_undo() != 56656) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_undo_finish() != 21115) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_method_session_undo_step() != 62409) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_constructor_nulllistener_new() != 57960) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_constructor_session_open() != 35846) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }
    if (uniffi_firstcut_core_checksum_constructor_session_open_in() != 54317) {
        return InitializationResult.apiChecksumMismatch
    }

    uniffiCallbackInitFfiSessionListener()
    return InitializationResult.ok
}()

// Make the ensure init function public so that other modules which have external type references to
// our types can call it.
public func uniffiEnsureFirstcutCoreInitialized() {
    switch initializationResult {
    case .ok:
        break
    case .contractVersionMismatch:
        fatalError("UniFFI contract version mismatch: try cleaning and rebuilding your project")
    case .apiChecksumMismatch:
        fatalError("UniFFI API checksum mismatch: try cleaning and rebuilding your project")
    }
}
